$comment: Structured version of CLAUDE.md's checklist and 'Keep these in sync' table - a machine-readable list of 'when trigger changes, review these targets too', derived from real incidents (not speculative). Read this at the start of any change touching a trigger; CLAUDE.md has the full incident-by-incident story behind each edge. 'path' is relative to this repo's root unless 'repo' says otherwise. An 'automated' field on a target means a real check already covers it (name the check); its absence means only a human/LLM re-reading the file catches drift.

edges.trigger: A new type/DU/field is added to the F# core's model (Worksheet/Workbook or anything they contain)
edges.seeAlso: CLAUDE.md 'Adding a feature to the DSL - checklist', steps 1-3

targets.check: handles the new case
handles the new case
F# source-gen renders the new case
XML surface (toWorkbook/ofWorkbook) covers it

targets.automated: verifyScenarioNamed validates every generated workbook.xml against Xml.xsd

targets.automated: verifyScenarioNamed validates every generated workbook.json via JsonTests.assertJsonSchemaValid (test-suite only, not a public API)

targets.check: new round-trip test added
new round-trip test added

edges.trigger: Any of the three <Version> fields is bumped (Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl.fsproj, Kookerella.CsOpenXmlDsl.csproj, Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl.Mcp.fsproj)
edges.seeAlso: CLAUDE.md step 5, 'Keep these in sync' table

targets.check: both version fields (top-level and packages[0].version) match Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl.Mcp.fsproj's <Version> - only relevant when the Mcp version itself changed

run `dotnet fake run build.fsx -t PublishAll` - never a standalone Push* target or a manual dotnet pack/nuget push, both of which are exactly how the wrapper's and Mcp's own dependency-floor/bundle staleness bugs happened
targets.automated: build.fsx VerifyDependencyFreshness (wrapper dependency floor, Mcp bundled-DLL freshness, server.json version), run as PublishAll's own action

edges.trigger: Mcp package's version changed and it's ready to ship

targets.check: mcp-publisher login github, then mcp-publisher publish from src/Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl.Mcp/.mcp/ - needs an interactive GitHub device-flow login, can't run inside a script; the publish itself rejects a NuGet version that isn't indexed yet, which is the signal to wait, not a real failure
